messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: billing-meter-emitter (eu-west) reporting +28% token delta vs baseline over the last 10m. Overages and customer flags may be triggered. Paging @oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-variance
Ana: on it — taking pager. quick glance shows a surge in emitter-to-aggregator lag, looks like some emitters spiking retries. grabbing queries now :eyes:
Mike: I ran a quick check against prod-agg: ```sql
-- tokens emitted by emitter shard (last 15m)
SELECT shard_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM meter_emitter.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY shard_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;
-- result: shard-7 = 12.4M, shard-3 = 11.8M (expected ~1.2M)
```
Sam: we've started to see overage flags firing and a small set of billing emails queued. Can we suppress automated overage email sends until we understand root cause? cc @Julia
Julia: support has 3 customers who opened tickets about unexpected invoice preview spikes (sample ids: RWD-2043, RWD-2048, RWD-2051). They're asking for ETA.
Ana: plan: 1) suppress overage notifications 2) failover aggregator reads to fallback consumer (non-realtime) to stop double-counting from retries 3) spawn a backfill/compare job to reconcile emitted vs ingested 4) handoff to SRE for longer term. Any objections?
Mike: agree. commands I will run now: ```bash
# suppress automated billing emails
curl -XPOST https://billing.internal/api/flags/suppress -d '{"reason":"incident 1758881010","ttl":3600}'
# switch aggregator to fallback consumer
kubectl patch deployment meter-aggregator -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"agg-mode":"fallback"}}}}}'
```
ops-bot: Executing job: POST /api/flags/suppress — 200 OK. patch deployment triggered, rollout started (deployment/meter-aggregator) :rocket:
Ana: :white_check_mark: suppress done, aggregator patched. starting comparison job and tailing logs. Mike — can you scope if it's emitter duplication vs upstream replay?
Mike: looking at emitter logs now — seeing repeated ack timeouts from shard-7 with retry bursts (correlated with a transient redis timeout around 2024-11-02T03:11:23Z). snippet: ```
[2024-11-02T03:11:23Z] shard-7 WARN emit retry count=4 err=\"redis timeout\"
[2024-11-02T03:11:24Z] shard-7 INFO emit success tokens=342000
[2024-11:12:01Z] shard-7 WARN emit retry count=5 err=\"upstream backpressure\"
```
Sam: ok if it's retries causing duplicates, suppressing notifications and switching aggregator should stop new customer-visible spikes. we'll prepare a manual crediting play if needed.
Julia: posting to customers now: "We're investigating a billing telemetry issue that may show inflated preview usage. We're pausing automated overage notices and will follow up within 2 hours." ping me if we need to escalate to legal/finance.
Ana: comparison job shows emitter sum > aggregator ingested by ~26% for last 30m. launching dedupe/backfill: job id bf-1758881010. I'll keep this thread updated with diffs.
Mike: starting a targeted restart of shard-7 emitter (graceful) to stop the retry loop: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/shard-7-emitter -n prod` — rolling restart kicked off.
ops-bot: rollout restart accepted for statefulset/shard-7-emitter — 3 pods restarting.
Ana: quick sanity check after restart — emitter rates dropped to expected, aggregator lag reduced. backfill progress 12% (expected ~45m total).
Sam: I've paused the billing preview worker that would have sent emails for flagged accounts — no further emails will go out. Will prepare a customer credit plan and hold until reconciled.
Julia: support updated ticket statuses and added the canned note. Customers on watchlist: RWD-2043 flagged as "monitoring".
Mike: logs show redis instance rds-eu-1 had a 90s stall, ops confirmed a transient IO spike on that host at 03:11Z. I've opened infra issue INF-892 and attached metrics.
Ana: handing off to Mike for next 8h to finish backfill/verify reconciles. I'll remain available for comms. If backfill finishes and diffs <1%, we can re-enable overage emails and close incident.
Mike: acknowledged, taking ownership. leaving a follow-up note in pager duty. will post final reconciliation and timeline. :spiral_notepad:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (suppression + aggregator fallback + shard restart). Customer-visible emails paused. Next update in 30m or when backfill completes.
Ana: thanks team — nice job moving fast. final note: add a post-incident action to harden redis failover and add emitter-side idempotency guard.
Mike: noted in INF-892 and TASK-1345 (idempotency work).
Ana: handing off thread to Mike — closing active paging for oncall. :handshake:
